translator_notes: Origin unclear, reads like a 20th-century composed song but I cannot name an author. 'проклета да си од либето' is my reading: 'cursed be you for the sweetheart (who parted us)'.

lines.en: Do you know, dear mother,
how unhappy I am,
I always sit at home alone,
I do not dare go outside.

lines.cyr: Еј мила мајко проклета да си
lines.lat: Ej mila majko prokleta da si
lines.en: Hey dear mother, may you be cursed

lines.cyr: Еј од либето што ме раздели.
lines.lat: Ej od libeto što me razdeli.
lines.en: Hey, for the sweetheart who parted me from him.
For the sweetheart who parted me from him
against my will,
he left pain in my chest
and frost on my heart.

lines.cyr: Дали пак тој ќе се врати

so that I can wait for him,

that I will die.
